value.note: big semicircular hood/ring around the dial, centred on the dial; lower half continues as a full ring frame

pilaster_figures.note: alternating small relief figures (boxes with a rounded top) and gilt stars up each corner pilaster, ~0.26 m apart

showcase_frame.head: shouldered arch with a small scroll at each shoulder

hood_rings.note: three stepped concentric rings around the dial, the outer one proud

wing_scrolls.note: the flared brackets beside the dial end in a scroll at the outer tip

ornaments.source: ref/04.jpg overview + 1:1 grids (ornament positions estimated from the 1:1 grids; sizes ±20 %); loop r6: volutes moved inside the feet, flutes taller (section sheet ghosts)

cornice.note: projecting slab with an ogee underside (replaces the crown profile's top)

lattice.note: dark openwork panel, one each side of the centre on every face

swag.note: hanging garland (half-torus arc) over each lattice panel

star.note: gold star in the middle of each face

corner_blocks.note: horizontally ribbed blocks at the four corners

dome.profile: quarter-ellipse: half-side(t) = top_w/2 + (foot_w-top_w)/2 * sqrt(1 - t^2), t = 0 at the foot -> 1 at the top

hip_rope.note: twisted cable moulding along each of the 4 hips, foot to top plate (approximate the twist by a chain of short tilted cylinders or a 6-sided helix)

hip_volute.note: scroll at the foot of each hip, sitting on the cornice corner, axis along the diagonal

trefoil.note: three gold lobes inside the ring, ring stands upright facing -Y (and a second one facing +X, crossed)

top.source: previews/top_ref01_zoom.png (ref/01.jpg x 470-900, y 40-500, 2x): scale 1.83 mm per zoom px from the ball radius (0.137 m, agreed by both photos); anchored at the cornice top 4.48 m (zoom y 690). ref/04 (close, from below) projects the set-back upper parts too low, so these heights come from ref/01; top round 2 (photo vs model): dome foot set in from the cornice (one face spans ~255 zoom px foreshortened ~45 deg -> ~0.78 m); broad ledge around it; two-photo signed errors (ref/04 close shift camera RMS 10.5, ref/01 RMS 30.6): cornice/frieze/dome +0.07 m (both photos: crown projects low)

value.gradient: vertical, glass_top at the pane top -> glass_bottom at the pane bottom

streaks.note: two light diagonal reflection bands per pane

glass_look.source: part sheet glass r1: panes read light and reflective in both photos; the engine has no transparency, so the reflection is baked
